selection_signal: 90th percentile of mutual nearest 3D pointmap correspondence distance for an accepted temporal Region link, normalized by that scene's E3a global median local spacing

threshold_derivation.method: 90th percentile across accepted adjacent-Keyframe Region-link scores from scene-level validation runs; no GT labels or test scenes used

refinement.parameterization: bounded radial depth along each fixed Keyframe camera ray; pose and non-target points remain fixed
refinement.loss: confidence-weighted squared loss with displacement prior; Huber reweighting disabled
refinement.confidence_weights: confidence_avg divided by scene median, clipped to [0.1, 10]

protocol_note: Frozen H4 ablation config: only robust loss changes from the Huber baseline; selection, plane gates, confidence weights, displacement bound, and rollback gate remain fixed.
